intent: A panel anchored to a trigger. Click opens it. Escape and a click outside close it.
useWhen: A small panel of content or actions anchored to a button
Something that should not take over the page the way a Modal does
doNotUseWhen: One or two sentences of help — use HelpPopover
A menu of commands — use DropdownMenu

trigger.note: One focusable control. Click toggles the panel.

requirements: Trigger gets aria-haspopup=dialog, aria-expanded, and aria-controls
Panel is role=dialog and labelled by label
Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger
A pointer down outside the trigger and the panel closes it
Tab can reach the controls inside the panel

doNot: Do not use Popover for help text — use HelpPopover
Do not use Popover as a date or select menu — use DatePicker, DateRangePicker, or Select
snippet: <Popover label="Share" trigger={<Button appearance="outline" mode="neutral">Share</Button>}>Copy the link.</Popover>
